_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.

_status: Session 92 dug one layer deeper on your Saddleback screenshot. The 'Select a college…' rows were just the no-college-picked view — but underneath was a real defect: when c-id.net says a college holds a C-ID approval and the course itself is missing from our COCI snapshot (very common right now — colleges are renumbering to the new statewide C1000 numbers, so old rows are gone and new ones haven't landed), the approval vanished and the slot showed a wrong blank. That was 1,195 wrong blanks across 114 colleges. Now EVERY official approval lands: matched to the real course where we can (smarter joins), or shown as a clearly-badged 'per c-id.net — verify' row when the course isn't in our snapshot. Blanks that remain are TRUE (the college holds no approval — e.g. Saddleback's AJ 120–160). A safety review caught and fixed a subtle bug before shipping (title matching could grab a sibling course like 'Part B' of a two-part sequence — now impossible). Also mapped YOUR new goal (confidence score + can't-submit-misaligned before the mid-July Institute) against the data we hold: everything's in hand except CONTACT HOURS — see the new data-requirements note and the two questions below.
